content.short: Supra is a middleware network providing oracle, cross-chain automation, and verifiable randomness services to Web3 apps on Mantle.
content.description: Supra is a comprehensive blockchain middleware network providing oracle services, cross-chain automation, and verifiable randomness (dVRF) for Web3 applications, operating its own high-performance consensus mechanism to deliver oracle data at speeds and costs not achievable by traditional oracle networks. Supra's integration with Mantle provides developers with fast, reliable oracle feeds and on-chain automation capabilities for building sophisticated dApps on the network.
